name: io.github.japage1928/epic-video
title: Epic Video
description: Generate short AI videos with sound from text prompts, with optional locked characters.

tools.name: create_video
tools.description: Generate a short AI video with synced sound from a text prompt using Epic Video. Videos are 5, 15, 30, 60 or 120 seconds long; anything over 15 seconds is stitched from chained 5-second clips for consistency. Videos cost tokens per second: 1 token/sec at 480p, 2 tokens/sec at 720p (e.g. a 15-second 480p video costs 15 tokens). Free plans get 15 tokens/week and can make videos up to 15 seconds; 60/120 require the Creator plan ($19.99/mo, 480 tokens/month released 120/week). $4.99/mo = 120 tokens/month released 30/week; $9.99/mo = 240 tokens/month released 60/week. Paid users can also spend top-up tokens bought on the website. Paid plans can attach a locked character (get its id from list_characters) so the same character appears in the video. Image-to-video: pass image_url (a public image URL) and the video will start from that image as its first frame and animate it — the prompt then describes the motion. Returns a job id — poll get_job_status until the status is 'done' to get the video URL. Check get_my_usage first to see the user's tokens left this week/month and top-up balance.

prompt.description: What the video should show, e.g. 'a red sports car on a coastal highway at golden hour, waves crashing'. With image_url, describe the motion instead, e.g. 'the car pulls away and speeds down the coast, camera tracking'.

image_url.description: Optional public URL of an image (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB) to animate: the video starts from this image as its first frame (image-to-video). The server fetches and validates the image; private/loopback addresses are rejected.

duration_s.description: Length in seconds: 5, 15, 30, 60 or 120. Free plans: up to 15. 60/120 require the Creator plan ($19.99/mo). Cost is duration x rate: 1 token/sec at 480p, 2 tokens/sec at 720p.

character_id.description: Optional id of a locked character from list_characters, so that character appears in the video. Paid plans only.

quality.description: Requested quality. The actual quality is set by the user's plan (free and $4.99 plans render 480p; the $9.99 and Creator plans use the user's 720p/480p switch). The returned job shows the real quality used.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Check the status of an Epic Video generation job by its job id. Returns the status (queued, rendering, upscaling, done, or failed) and, when done, the video URL.

job_id.description: The job id returned by create_video.

tools.name: list_my_videos
tools.description: List the signed-in Epic Video user's finished videos, newest first, with playback URLs.

limit.description: Maximum number of videos to return.

tools.name: get_my_usage
tools.description: Show the signed-in Epic Video user's plan tier, plan tokens left in the current rolling 7-day window and this month, top-up (bonus) token balance, and per-second token rates (1 token/sec at 480p, 2 tokens/sec at 720p).

tools.name: list_characters
tools.description: List the Epic Video characters available to the signed-in user — their own locked characters plus shared presets — for use with create_video's character_id.
